summary: Thursday's close was driven by a sharp flight to safety: long Treasuries surged, credit spreads cracked, and equity volatility jumped, punishing growth names as tech badly lagged defensive staples. That rotation pushed stocks into fear while bonds stayed calm and gold's safe-haven bid remained muted.
tweet: A volatility-driven flight to safety hit stocks Thursday: Treasuries surged, credit spreads cracked, and tech cratered versus staples, dragging equity sentiment into fear.
